biggest_catch: You must apply and pass each study's screening — pay is per completed study only, so this is inconsistent side income, not a paycheck; the best-paying studies target specific professional backgrounds.
catches: Each study has its own screening questions — you will not qualify for every study you apply to.
Pay is per completed study; no study, no pay.
Study availability varies by your demographics, profession, and location.
Payments go through Tremendous (PayPal, bank transfer, or gift cards) — you need a payout method set up.

c1.evidence: Official Respondent participant FAQ on respondent.io describes the study marketplace, vetting, and payment process.

c2.evidence: Official FAQ: 'A focus group is a small group discussing a topic together, usually 60–90 minutes, paying $100–$400+.' Also: 'Focus groups and in-person studies pay the most — averaging $150–$250 per session.'

c3.evidence: Official FAQ: 'Payments are sent through Tremendous once your study is complete — most participants are paid within a few days of their session.'

c4.evidence: Official FAQ: 'you'll never be asked to pay to participate.'

eligibility: Anyone; create a free profile; matched to studies by background, profession, and interests; per-study screening questions
maximize: Fill out your profile completely — Respondent says the more complete your profile, the more studies you'll match with; apply to lots of studies since there's no monthly limit and each has its own screening; prioritize focus groups and in-person studies because the official FAQ says those average $150–$250 per session, the highest pay on the platform.

s4.note: Free to join; never asked to pay — stated on official FAQ.

steps: Create a free participant profile at respondent.io
Browse available studies or get matched by the algorithm
Answer each study's quick screening questions
If selected, participate remotely or in person
Get paid via Tremendous (PayPal, bank, or gift cards) within a few days of your session
timing: Payments sent through Tremendous once your study is complete — most participants paid within a few days of their session.
